name: 43528 · Holland, OH
findings: ZIP 43528 (Holland) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43528 (Holland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
